BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsᵉʻîyrâh, meaning smallness (of age). It appears once, in Genesis 43:33.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsᵉʻîyrâh matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
